_note: helix-auth validate rejects before api-product-enforcer runs, so an unauthenticated request consumes no quota. The response body is whatever your gateway build emits for an auth rejection — assert the STATUS, not this shape.
_distinguish: 401 = the gateway does not know who you are. 403 = it knows, but no product covers this route (or the route has no service_id). 429 = it knows, it found your product, and your window is spent. These look similar in a dashboard and mean entirely different things.
